+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
+import {
+  QueryCache,
+  QueryClient,
+  createPersisterRestoreResult,
+  isPersisterRestoreResult,
+  reconcileQueryState,
+} from '..'
+import type { QueryState } from '..'
+
+describe('persister restore helpers and query fetch restoration', () => {
+  it('createPersisterRestoreResult creates a valid restore result marker', () => {
+    const state: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'test-data',
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+      error: new Error('test-error'),
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 1050,
+      fetchFailureCount: 2,
+      fetchFailureReason: new Error('test-error'),
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: true,
+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const restoreResult = createPersisterRestoreResult({
+      data: 'test-data',
+      state,
+    })
+
+    expect(isPersisterRestoreResult(restoreResult)).toBe(true)
+    expect(restoreResult.data).toBe('test-data')
+    expect(restoreResult.state).toEqual(state)
+    expect(isPersisterRestoreResult({ data: 'test-data' })).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  describe('reconcileQueryState', () => {
+    it('merges data and error freshness independently (live newer data + restored newer error)', () => {
+      const liveState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+        data: 'live-newer-data',
+        dataUpdateCount: 2,
+        dataUpdatedAt: 2000,
+        error: null,
+        errorUpdateCount: 0,
+        errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+        fetchFailureCount: 0,
+        fetchFailureReason: null,
+        fetchMeta: null,
+        isInvalidated: false,
+        status: 'success',
+        fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      }
+
+      const restoredState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+        data: 'restored-older-data',
+        dataUpdateCount: 1,
+        dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+        error: new Error('restored-newer-error'),
+        errorUpdateCount: 1,
+        errorUpdatedAt: 1500,
+        fetchFailureCount: 3,
+        fetchFailureReason: new Error('restored-newer-error'),
+        fetchMeta: null,
+        isInvalidated: true,
+        status: 'error',
+        fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      }
+
+      const reconciled = reconcileQueryState(liveState, restoredState)
+
+      expect(reconciled.data).toBe('live-newer-data')
+      expect(reconciled.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(2000)
+      expect(reconciled.error?.message).toBe('restored-newer-error')
+      expect(reconciled.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(1500)
+      expect(reconciled.fetchFailureCount).toBe(3)
+      expect(reconciled.status).toBe('error')
+      expect(reconciled.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+      expect(reconciled.isInvalidated).toBe(true)
+    })
+
+    it('merges data and error freshness independently (live newer error + restored newer data)', () => {
+      const liveState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+        data: 'live-older-data',
+        dataUpdateCount: 1,
+        dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+        error: new Error('live-newer-error'),
+        errorUpdateCount: 1,
+        errorUpdatedAt: 2500,
+        fetchFailureCount: 2,
+        fetchFailureReason: new Error('live-newer-error'),
+        fetchMeta: null,
+        isInvalidated: false,
+        status: 'error',
+        fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      }
+
+      const restoredState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+        data: 'restored-newer-data',
+        dataUpdateCount: 2,
+        dataUpdatedAt: 2000,
+        error: null,
+        errorUpdateCount: 0,
+        errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+        fetchFailureCount: 0,
+        fetchFailureReason: null,
+        fetchMeta: null,
+        isInvalidated: false,
+        status: 'success',
+        fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      }
+
+      const reconciled = reconcileQueryState(liveState, restoredState)
+
+      expect(reconciled.data).toBe('restored-newer-data')
+      expect(reconciled.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(2000)
+      expect(reconciled.error?.message).toBe('live-newer-error')
+      expect(reconciled.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(2500)
+      expect(reconciled.fetchFailureCount).toBe(2)
+      expect(reconciled.status).toBe('error')
+      expect(reconciled.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+    })
+  })
+
+  it('query.fetch adopts restored state and does not trigger onSuccess/onSettled callbacks', async () => {
+    const onSuccessSpy = vi.fn()
+    const onSettledSpy = vi.fn()
+
+    const queryCache = new QueryCache({
+      onSuccess: onSuccessSpy,
+      onSettled: onSettledSpy,
+    })
+    const queryClient = new QueryClient({ queryCache })
+
+    const key = ['restoredQueryKey']
+
+    const restoredQueryState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'persisted-data',
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 12345,
+      error: new Error('refetch-failed'),
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 12350,
+      fetchFailureCount: 4,
+      fetchFailureReason: new Error('refetch-failed'),
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: true,
+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const persister = vi.fn(() =>
+      Promise.resolve(
+        createPersisterRestoreResult({
+          data: restoredQueryState.data,
+          state: restoredQueryState,
+        }),
+      ),
+    )
+
+    const result = await queryClient.fetchQuery({
+      queryKey: key,
+      queryFn: () => Promise.resolve('fresh-data'),
+      persister: persister as any,
+    })
+
+    expect(result).toBe('persisted-data')
+    expect(onSuccessSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(onSettledSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+
+    const query = queryCache.find({ queryKey: key })!
+    expect(query.state.data).toBe('persisted-data')
+    expect(query.state.error?.message).toBe('refetch-failed')
+    expect(query.state.fetchFailureCount).toBe(4)
+    expect(query.state.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(12345)
+    expect(query.state.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(12350)
+    expect(query.state.isInvalidated).toBe(true)
+    expect(query.state.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+    expect(query.state.status).toBe('error')
+  })
+
+  it('prefetchQuery works with persister restoring snapshot state', async () => {
+    const queryCache = new QueryCache()
+    const queryClient = new QueryClient({ queryCache })
+
+    const key = ['prefetchKey']
+    const restoredState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'prefetched-persisted-data',
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 5000,
+      error: null,
+      errorUpdateCount: 0,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+      fetchFailureCount: 0,
+      fetchFailureReason: null,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: false,
+      status: 'success',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    await queryClient.prefetchQuery({
+      queryKey: key,
+      queryFn: () => Promise.resolve('fresh'),
+      persister: () =>
+        Promise.resolve(
+          createPersisterRestoreResult({
+            data: restoredState.data,
+            state: restoredState,
+          }),
+        ),
+    })
+
+    const query = queryCache.find({ queryKey: key })!
+    expect(query.state.data).toBe('prefetched-persisted-data')
+    expect(query.state.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(5000)
+    expect(query.state.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+  })
+})

+import type { DefaultError, QueryStatus } from './types'
+import type { QueryState } from './query'
+
+const persisterRestoreResultSymbol = Symbol.for(
+  'tanstack.query.persisterRestoreResult',
+)
+
+export interface PersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+> {
+  data?: TData
+  state?: QueryState<TData, TError>
+  [persisterRestoreResultSymbol]?: boolean
+}
+
+export function createPersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+>(result: {
+  data?: TData
+  state?: QueryState<TData, TError>
+}): PersisterRestoreResult<TData, TError> {
+  return {
+    data: result.data,
+    state: result.state,
+    [persisterRestoreResultSymbol]: true,
+  }
+}
+
+export function isPersisterRestoreResult(
+  value: unknown,
+): value is PersisterRestoreResult {
+  return (
+    typeof value === 'object' &&
+    value !== null &&
+    (value as any)[persisterRestoreResultSymbol] === true
+  )
+}
+
+export function reconcileQueryState<TData = unknown, TError = DefaultError>(
+  currentState: QueryState<TData, TError>,
+  restoredState: QueryState<TData, TError>,
+): QueryState<TData, TError> {
+  const currentDataUpdatedAt = currentState?.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0
+  const restoredDataUpdatedAt = restoredState?.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0
+
+  let data: TData | undefined
+  let dataUpdatedAt: number
+  let dataUpdateCount: number
+
+  if (currentDataUpdatedAt > restoredDataUpdatedAt) {
+    data = currentState.data
+    dataUpdatedAt = currentDataUpdatedAt
+    dataUpdateCount = currentState?.dataUpdateCount ?? 0
+  } else if (restoredDataUpdatedAt > currentDataUpdatedAt) {
+    data = restoredState.data
+    dataUpdatedAt = restoredDataUpdatedAt
+    dataUpdateCount = restoredState?.dataUpdateCount ?? 0
+  } else {
+    if (restoredState?.data !== undefined) {
+      data = restoredState.data
+      dataUpdatedAt = restoredDataUpdatedAt
+      dataUpdateCount = restoredState?.dataUpdateCount ?? 0
+    } else {
+      data = currentState?.data
+      dataUpdatedAt = currentDataUpdatedAt
+      dataUpdateCount = currentState?.dataUpdateCount ?? 0
+    }
+  }
+
+  const currentErrorUpdatedAt = currentState?.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0
+  const restoredErrorUpdatedAt = restoredState?.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0
+
+  let error: TError | null
+  let errorUpdatedAt: number
+  let errorUpdateCount: number
+  let fetchFailureCount: number
+  let fetchFailureReason: TError | null
+
+  if (currentErrorUpdatedAt > restoredErrorUpdatedAt) {
+    error = currentState?.error ?? null
+    errorUpdatedAt = currentErrorUpdatedAt
+    errorUpdateCount = currentState?.errorUpdateCount ?? 0
+    fetchFailureCount = currentState?.fetchFailureCount ?? 0
+    fetchFailureReason = currentState?.fetchFailureReason ?? null
+  } else if (restoredErrorUpdatedAt > currentErrorUpdatedAt) {
+    error = restoredState?.error ?? null
+    errorUpdatedAt = restoredErrorUpdatedAt
+    errorUpdateCount = restoredState?.errorUpdateCount ?? 0
+    fetchFailureCount = restoredState?.fetchFailureCount ?? 0
+    fetchFailureReason = restoredState?.fetchFailureReason ?? null
+  } else {
+    if (restoredState?.error != null) {
+      error = restoredState.error
+      errorUpdatedAt = restoredErrorUpdatedAt
+      errorUpdateCount = restoredState?.errorUpdateCount ?? 0
+      fetchFailureCount = restoredState?.fetchFailureCount ?? 0
+      fetchFailureReason = restoredState?.fetchFailureReason ?? null
+    } else {
+      error = currentState?.error ?? null
+      errorUpdatedAt = currentErrorUpdatedAt
+      errorUpdateCount = currentState?.errorUpdateCount ?? 0
+      fetchFailureCount = currentState?.fetchFailureCount ?? 0
+      fetchFailureReason = currentState?.fetchFailureReason ?? null
+    }
+  }
+
+  let status: QueryStatus
+  if (error !== null) {
+    status = 'error'
+  } else if (data !== undefined) {
+    status = 'success'
+  } else {
+    status = restoredState?.status ?? currentState?.status ?? 'pending'
+  }
+
+  const isInvalidated =
+    Boolean(restoredState?.isInvalidated) || Boolean(currentState?.isInvalidated)
+  const fetchMeta = currentState?.fetchMeta ?? restoredState?.fetchMeta ?? null
+
+  return {
+    data,
+    dataUpdatedAt,
+    dataUpdateCount,
+    error,
+    errorUpdatedAt,
+    errorUpdateCount,
+    fetchFailureCount,
+    fetchFailureReason,
+    fetchMeta,
+    isInvalidated,
+    status,
+    fetchStatus: 'idle',
+  }
+}
